items.title: Differentials are stable under arbitrary base change for algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a base change g : Y' -> Y with projection g' : X' = X_{Y'} -> X, the canonical map (g')^* Omega_{X/Y} -> Omega_{X'/Y'} constructed in the chapter's lemma-functoriality-differentials is an isomorphism. The retained proof gives the reduction: it follows from the schemes version, Morphisms, lemma-base-change-differentials, and etale localization, see lemma-localize-differentials. Retained author proof at lines 1219-1224.
